patches.name: Bypass unofficial APK check
patches.description: Disables the 'Unofficial APK detected! Closing app.' signature check so the app no longer force-closes when the signing certificate does not match the official one.

patches.name: Unlock ad-gated settings
patches.description: Changes the 'Watch ad to unlock' button label to 'Unlock' and makes the button invoke the original feature callback directly without showing a rewarded advertisement.
